register_gap: The onboarding holds a four-size ladder per canvas (12pt tracked-caps eyebrow, one 46-48pt serif king, 19-24pt body/value, 19pt ghost footer) with exactly ONE tracked-caps event per screen and 30-65% of the canvas as a single pool of cream; the app surfaces run eight to ten simultaneous sizes with three to eleven caps events (Home stacks MONDAY JULY 27 / DAY 12 · WEEK 2 OF 20 / FROM JENI inside the first 110pt; becoming prints eleven caps settings and six chevrons on one screen). Numeral discipline collapses: onboarding gives a number one voice at one size (the 500 didone at ~60pt with an italic serif unit), while the weight page sets 163.6 twice in two faces 600pt apart (serif at 30pt, then DMSans at 24pt in the STARTED/NOW/GOAL triptych), and Home's 860 is a 40pt fragment inside a three-register line. Air still exists in the app but it is chopped into 16-32pt inter-row gutters and orphaned bottom halves (the letter's mass sits top-third above 55% empty), so no screen has the onboarding's one confident emptiness. The grammar count is the tell: onboarding speaks one grammar per screen; Home speaks five (caps stack, editorial hero, stat line, utility row with chevron, dismissable banner with border-bar, pill and x).
onboarding_dna: One tracked-caps event per screen: 12-13pt DMSans caps at ~+0.15em tracking (HER ARRIVAL, HER FOOD STORY), centered, never stacked, never repeated below the header line.

One serif king per canvas: 44-48pt JeniHeroSerif at ~1.05 leading with exactly one italic accent word (here / before / heard); nothing else on the screen exceeds half its size, a clean 2:1 king-to-body ratio.

Numeral-as-display grammar (beat 13): 500 set in the didone at ~60pt with italic serif 'calories' at ~26pt hung on its baseline and '± 75' as a 15pt sidenote; one numeral voice per page, ledger numerals right-aligned to the margin (165 / 300 / 35).
Receipt ledger (beats 13, 19, 21): label 19pt secondary left, value 24pt right-aligned with serif-italic accent, 0.5pt hairlines (#EFE0DC) between rows, no fills, no chevrons, no instruction text.
Zero filled containers except one dark CTA pill per screen; selection chips are hairline outlines on bare cream (beat 16), ~44pt tall, 12pt gaps.

Empty cream is 30-65% of the canvas pooled in ONE place: below the question on left-aligned beats (beat 10 holds ~55% uninterrupted between sub and CTA), symmetric around the mass on centered ceremony beats (beat 19 opens with ~35% clear before the hero).
Ceremony is centered and closes with a ghost footer ('tap to continue') as the only affordance; question beats are flush-left with clean sense-driven rag; the screen never labels its own mechanics.
Even the sell-screen mock (beat 01) sets the checklist mark TRAILING the row, a receipt position, not a leading to-do checkbox.

screen_directions.direction: Enforce the ladder: one caps line 'MONDAY, JULY 27 · DAY 12' at 12pt replaces the current three-row caps stack; the 'DAY 12 · WEEK 2 OF 20 · FINDING STEADY >' row and the truncated 'FROM JENI back after 10 days. this is day 12, n...' teaser both die (week identity belongs to becoming's cover; a serif italic must never truncate mid-word). The day's number becomes the king: 860 rises from 40pt to the 64pt didone (JKType.numeralHero) with 'of ~1,473' as a 24pt italic hung beside it and 'room for ~600' as the single italic line below, so Home's center IS beat-13's receipt. 'snap the next plate' stays the only other serif event at 40pt; the steps row re-sets as a hairline ledger row (label left, 6,420 in serif right, no chevron, no 'counted for you' sub); the cycle banner loses border-bar, connect pill and x, surviving as one tappable rose italic line. What grows: the numeral and one uninterrupted pool of cream between receipt and tab bar. What the screen becomes: a morning ceremony, one caps line, one serif sentence, one numeral receipt, one kept line.

The landing stops impersonating Home's ledger and becomes a COVER: 'becoming' masthead, one caps line WEEK 2 OF 20, jeni's read promoted to 48pt (the largest type in the app, a cover is allowed that), one italic subdeck, and the seven signals compressed from the 7-row eyebrow-plus-chevron index into a single serif contents run set in interpuncts (weight · food · plates · timing · sugar · night · sleep), tappable words, no chevrons, no 'tap to open', no HER SIGNALS eyebrow. Inside pages keep the hero grammar but obey one numeral voice: the STARTED/NOW/GOAL triptych re-sets in serif numerals 28pt over 11pt caps so 163.6 never appears in two faces on one page; charts go flat ink (one cocoa line, rose accent point, 0.5pt dashed goal, no 370pt gradient wash; bars in flat cocoa/rose, no gradient); the protein page's duplicated MORNING/AFTERNOON/EVENING caps row and the DMSans restatement of the italic insight are deleted, every fact printed exactly once. Caps events fall from eleven to two per canvas. The tab becomes a feature well: cover, then full-bleed story pages flipped horizontally.

Already the closest surface to the signed standard; finish it. The JENI + hairline + italic 'monday' dateline is the best-set line in the app, keep it untouched. The letter body rises from 34pt to the onboarding king size 40-44pt and the text mass moves to optical center with symmetric air (beat 19's ceremony placement) instead of top-third above 55% orphaned cream. One action only: the ghost 'keep it ♥' footer stays, the dark reply pill leaves (replying belongs to the chat room), 'jeni ♥' remains the right-aligned italic sign-off. What grows: the letter itself and the silence around it. What the screen becomes: a folded note opened at the middle of the page, the app's sacred typographic moment set at its largest reading size.

Kill the iMessage costume: bubble fills and tails die. Jeni's turns become flush-left serif paragraphs at 24pt under 11pt caps timestamps, separated by the already-elegant hairline-interrupted italic 'today' dateline; the user's turns right-align in rose (accent #C4677A) DMSans with no container, so at most one filled surface remains on screen (the input field). The pinned trend card loses its white box and border: hairline above and below, sparkline in flat cocoa ink, 'open the full trend' as 11pt caps with arrow. What grows: jeni's prose reads visually larger unboxed even at the same point size, and the thread inherits the letter's correspondence register so the two rooms rhyme. What the screen becomes: an exchange of short letters down one page, not a texting app on cream.

checklist_signature.at_rest: No circles, no boxes, no 'still open' captions. Each open item is an unbalanced ledger row: the action set flush-left in 26pt serif cocoa, the right-hand value column (where every number in this house lives, onboarding beats 13/19) standing EMPTY, a 0.5pt hairline at 12% cocoa beneath. Openness is shown by the blank value slot, never told; the whole row is the tap target with zero affordance chrome.
checklist_signature.completion: On tap the ✦ jeni mark draws itself into the empty value column at 20pt rose (#C4677A), four strokes over ~450ms like a pen tick, while the item's serif eases to 45% cocoa and a 1.5pt rose silk line draws left-to-right along the x-height, the register of a countersignature, not a strikethrough. Haptics are a two-beat seal: one soft tap as the finger lands, one warmer tap timed to the ✦'s final stroke. The hairline below blushes rose for a breath, then settles. The mark sits TRAILING, filling the ledger's value slot, exactly where the onboarding's own sell-screen mock (beat 01) placed its checks.
checklist_signature.day_complete: When the last row seals, the per-row hairlines dissolve, one rule draws itself beneath the whole block, each ✦ drifts up to 8pt to align into a single right-hand column (a ~600ms settling, one soft haptic swell), and under the rule the day's total appears in 24pt serif italic: 'monday, kept ♥'. The checklist has become a signed receipt: labels left, seals right, one rule, one dated italic line. No confetti, no counters, no green.
checklist_signature.why_inevitable: It is the receipt grammar the user was taught twice before day one (the 165/300/35 ledger of beat 13, the label-left value-right receipt of beat 19): a day is a ledger, doing the thing writes the row's value, jeni's mark IS the value, and the rule beneath totals it. Completion is the row balancing itself; no other mark in the vocabulary could close it.

becoming_pagination.description: The roman folio dies; position becomes the magazine's running head, sewn to the bottom margin. The cover's contents run reappears as an 11pt serif thread (weight · food · plates · timing · sugar · night · sleep) with the current signal's word set in rose italic and its neighbors faded to 25% cocoa; swiping slides the thread at half the page's speed, a sewn-spine parallax, so the pages feel stitched onto it, and the current word settles to center as the page lands. Position is felt by NAME and weight, not number: you are at 'timing', not at iv of xii. Any word is tappable to jump; at rest the thread sits at hairline quietness and wakes only during the swipe.

one_transformative_move: Impose the onboarding's ladder law on every app canvas: exactly ONE serif king per screen (a 44-64pt hero or didone numeral), exactly ONE tracked-caps eyebrow, and everything else confined to the 19-26pt ledger register with hairlines. That single constraint forces Home's 860 to 64pt, the letter to 44pt, becoming's cover story to 48pt, and mechanically kills every second caps row, duplicate label, chevron and banner on contact, because a four-size ladder has no rung left for them.
